title: Homogeneity of the Gowers norm
statement: Let $n$ be a nonnegative integer, let $k$ be a positive integer, let $a\in\mathbb R$, and let $f\colon\mathbb F_2^n\to\mathbb R$. Then $\|af\|_{U^k}=|a|\,\|f\|_{U^k}$.
hypotheses_covered: $f$ is a real-valued function on $\mathbb F_2^n$
